summary: ZK International Group Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a change in its certifying accountant: effective April 2, 2026, it dismissed Fortune CPA, Inc. and on May 13, 2026 engaged Li CPA LLC as its new independent auditor for FY ending September 30, 2026. There were no adverse opinions, disagreements, or reportable events under Item 304 of Regulation S-K. This is a routine auditor change, not a special situation event. No deal terms, premium, or transaction structure are present.
